issues.quote: Net income was one hundred seventeen point two billion dollars
issues.problem: Apple's fiscal 2024 net income was about $93.7 billion, not $117.2 billion. It fell from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023, mainly because of a one-time charge of about $10.2 billion from the EU state aid tax ruling.

data.summary: Revenue, growth rate, operating income, total assets and cash are all correct. Net income is overstated: the analysis says $117.2B, but the actual figure was about $93.7B.
